tei:div.tei:p: /byin rlabs thugs sgrub ces bya ba bzhugs soḥ shog ser skor las: ka mā ma ga: byin rlabs bla ma'i thugs sgrub ces bya ba: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo: dngos grub kun 'byung padma la: btud nas byin rlabs thugs sgrub 'di: kun 'dus spyi ru bsgrub pa dang : mtshan brgyad bye brag bsgrub pa 'o: dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas: stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng : rang nyid hrīḥlas mtsho rgyal sku: mthing nag gri gug thod pa dang : kha ṭwāṃ rin chen rgyan rnams rdzogs: gcer bu rus pas brgyan par bsgom: nyin par spyi gtsug pad zla'i steng : zhi ba kun 'dus longs spyod rdzogs: dkar gsal za 'og ber chen gsol: pad zha rgod po'i rtse rgyal btsugs: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag ka pā la: bdud rtsis bkang bsnams skyil krung mdzad: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang gcer bu la: gri gug thod pa kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar stabs bzhugs: mu med 'od zer 'phro bar bsgom: mtshan dus rang gi snying ga ru: pad nyi'i steng du padma ni: yab yum he ru ka yi tshul: 'khril sbyor yab sngo rdo rje dril: yum dmar gri gug thod pas 'khyud: gnyis ka rin chen rus pas brgyan: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rgyan rnams rdzogs: de yi phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: yab yum 'khril sbyor rgyan rnams rdzogs: dkar ser dmar ljang gar stabs mdzad: phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul gtso bo 'dra: kun las 'od 'phros bdag gzhan gyi: sgo gsum sgrib sbyang dngos grub thob: zag med bde bas gang bar bsam : de ltar nyin mtshan sgom pa'i tshe: bla ma mkha' 'gro'i 'od zer gyis: bdag gzhan sgrib sbyangs dngos grub thob: yang cig sprul pa'i 'od zer las: bla ma mkha' 'gro dpag med spros: 'jig rten khams kun gang bar bsgom: kun gyis sngags 'di brjod par bsam: āoṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya tsitta hring hring dza dza:

ting 'dzin gsal bas ma yengs bzlas: dngos grub gang 'dod thob par bsam: rjes la thams cad bla mar thim: de yang mi dmigs chos nyid ngang : ma skyes gdod nas dag par bzhag: dge ba sems can don bsngos la: spyod lam rmi lam sgyu mar spyad: zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig na: dngos sam rmi lam gang rung du: slob dpon zhal mthong ci bsam 'grub: mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur: mtshan brgyad bye brag bsgrub pa la: dang po zhi ba mchog sgrub pas: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang : pad zla'i steng du rang sems hūm̐: 'od 'phros don byas tshur 'dus pas: padma 'byung gnas sku mdog dkar: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnol: skyil krung za 'og ber chen gsol: pad zhwa rgod po'i rtse rgyal btsugs: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro bsam: snying gar pad zla'i dbus su hūm̐: phyogs bzhir ha ri na sa 'o: de las 'od 'phros rang gzhan gyi: sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs dngos grub thob: snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gror bsgom: kun kyang hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: phaṭa kyi brda skad sangs se sang : bsgoms la hūm̐ glu ring du blangs: thun zhabs 'di yang bzla bar bya: āoṃ ha ri ni sa āḥhūm̐: rjes la sngar bzhin shes par bya: las dang sdig sgrib sbyang ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob: nad rnams zhi bar 'dod pa yis: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa las: hūm̐ las padma sam bha wa: dkar ljang rgyan sogs gong dang 'dra: phyag gnyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams: thugs kar pad zla'i dbus su hūm̐: phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa las: 'od 'phros bdag gzhan nad rnams bsregs: bdud rtsis lus khengs bde ba'i ngang : snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams: sngar bzhin hūṃ phaṭa sgrogs pa las: na sar hūm̐ gis zang thal phug: 'od 'phros nad rnams skar mda' bzhin: phyi rol nam mkha'i ngang du dengs: yang yang bsgoms la hūm̐ glu len: de rjes 'di yang bzla bar bya:

āoṃ ha ri ni sa āḥhūm̐: rjes la sngar bzhin bsgoms pa yis: nad rnams ma lus zhi bar 'gyur: gdon rnams zhi bar 'dod pa yis: pad zla'i steng du rang sems hūm̐: de las seng ge sgra sgrogs ni: dkar ser gtso 'khor sngar dang 'dra: phyag gnyis rdo rje ka pā la: thugs kar yig 'bru snga ma bzhin: 'od 'phros snang srid mkha' 'gro'i zhing : bgegs rnams tshar bcad me phung bsgoms: hūm̐ glu blangs rjes sngar bzhin bzlas: bar chad gdon bgegs bla mar bsgom: spyi gtsug spyan drangs gsol ba gdab: bar chad byang chub sems bsgom la: lan chags sbyang phyir rang gi lus: dum bur 'thor nas gang 'dod sbyin: lan chags bu lon khyer bar bsam: rjes la mnyam gzhag stong pa las: dge ba sems can don du bsngo: bgegs rnams zhi bar the tshom med: gnyis pa rgyas pa'i las bstan pa: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas 'dod na: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ las rang nyid shākya seng : ser gsal gtso 'khor snga ma bzhin: phyag gnyis rin chen ka pā la: thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su hūm̐: phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa ser: 'od 'phros 'khor 'das thams cad kyi: tshe dang bsod nams nor rnams bsdus: bdag la dngos grub thob par bsam: snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gro rnams: bdag la by-in rlabs dngos grub ster: hūm̐ phaṭa gdangs skad brjod par bsam: hūm̐ glu blangs rjes sngags 'di bzlas: āoṃ ri ni sa ha āḥhūm̐: rjes la thams cad bla ma la: de yang nam mkha'i ngang bzhag bsngo: tshe dang bsod nams 'byor pa 'khor: ci bsam yid bzhin lhun gyis grub: shes rab rgyas par 'dod pa yis: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ las blo ldan mchog sred ni: dmar ser gtso 'khor sngar bzhin la: phyag na glegs bam ka pā la: thugs kar pad nyi hūm̐ gi mthar: ha ri ni sa dmar ser ni: sgron me 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: lus nang khengs pas gti mug gi:

mun pa kun sangs shel sgong 'dra: 'od 'phros 'gro ba'i gti mug bsal: snang srid bla ma mkha' 'gror bsam: kun gyi 'chad rtsod rtsom pa dang : 'dzin bzang tshe dang gzi brjid sdud: snying ga'i yi ge lnga la thim: shes rab chen po thob par 'gyur: tshe dang shes rab bdud rtsi yis: rang gi lus khengs bde bar bsam: yang yang spro bsdu de bzhin bsgom: rlung bzung mnyam par gzhag par bya: de rjes spro bsdu sngar bzhin la: hūm̐ glu blang zhing ma yengs bsgom: rjes la rig sngags 'di yang bzlas: āoṃ ri ni sa ha āḥhūm̐: de rjes sngar bzhin spyad pa yis: shes rab 'phel ba'i rtags rnams 'byung : nyi shu gcig gis skal ldan par: 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med: gsum pa dbang gis las bstan pa: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang : hūm̐ las nyi ma 'od zer dmar: gtso 'khor sngar bzhin phyag gnyis na: pad ma dmar dang ka pā la: thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su hūm̐: phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa dmar: 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam par 'phros: khams gsum kun 'dus snying gar thim: yang 'phros snang srid mkha' 'gro'i zhing : tshur 'dus snying ga'i yi ger thim: yang 'phros gang mos bsgrub bya bkug: 'od gyur snying gar thim pa las: yang 'phros dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa'i tshogs: ba spu'i bu ga kun nas thon: sngar bzhin bkug nas bsgoms byas la: hūm̐ glu blangs shing sngags 'di bzlas: āoṃ ni ha sa ri āḥ hūm̐: che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa khug dzaḥhring hring : rjes la snang srid hūm̐ la bsdu: de yang mnyam rdzogs chos sku'i ngang : bde chen gza' gtad med par gzhag: dge ba byang chub thob phyir bsngo: zla ba phyed kyis skal ldan par: 'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med: bzhi pa drag po'i 'phrin las ni: bgegs chen dam sri ma rungs pa: 'tshe zhing bdag la gnod pa na: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stong pa'i ngang :

nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa ru: rdo rje rwa ba bla bres gur: ye shes me ri 'bar ba'i nang : padma nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐: 'od 'phros me yi 'khor lo ni: rno ngar mtshon cha'i rang bzhin la: rtsibs stong ldan pa 'khor bar bsam: da rjes hūm̐ las rang nyid ni: padma thod phreng mthing nag la: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan: phyag g.yas me yi 'khor lo bsnams: g.yon pa sdig mdzub thugs kar mdzad: stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang : thod skam sbrul nag chun pos brgyan: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor stabs tshul: zhal gcig spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs: dbu skra dmar ser ag tshom 'bar: thugs kar pad nyi'i dbus su hūm̐: phyogs bzhir ha ri ni sa mthing : nam mkha' khyab par bsgoms pa yis: rdo rje 'bar ba'i spu gseb nas: ye shes me stag rnam par 'phro: sprul pa'i khro chung 'phro 'du yis: bgegs rnams gzir gnon phye mar rlog: phyogs bzhir 'phros pa'i mkha' 'gro bzhi: gtso bo 'dra ba rnam par bsgom: snang srid me klong gcig tu 'khyil: me yi 'khor lo 'khor ba yis: gnod byed rgyal bsen dam sri rnams: me lce'i kha la sbrang bu bzhin: lus gtubs mes bsregs rdul phran bzhin: sku yi 'thor rlung bskyod pa yis: rlung gis sprin gtor dengs pa bzhin: gnod byed gnas 'khor yul gtor nas: rnam shes nam mkha'i dbyings su 'dres: sus kyang gnod pa med par bsam: de ltar 'phro 'du'i ting 'dzin gyis: snang srid khrau bo khro mo rnams: hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgra sgrogs pa yis: gnod byed gzir bar bsams byas la: hūm̐ glu ngar dang bcas pa blang : thun zhabs drag sngags 'di yang brjod: āoṃ sa ha ri ni āḥhūm̐: gnod byed 'byung po'i snying la mā ra ya phaṭa: ces bzlas rjes la chos nyid ngang : bgegs su 'dzin pa rang gi sems: sems ni kha dog dbyibs dang bral: srung dang bsrung bya med par bzhag: sems can don du bsngo ba bya:

bgegs rnams med cing bsam pa 'grub: de ltar bskyed rim legs bsgoms nas: 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i rim pa yang : dben zhing dngas la nyams dga' bar: skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed dang : mi rtag 'chi ba dran byas la: spyi bor bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom: snying nas gsol gdab byin rlabs bsam: de nas lta stangs gzigs stangs gcun: ka dag lhun grub 'od gsal bsgom: bying rgod bral bas brtson byas te: rjes la sems can don du bsngo: 'gro 'chag za nyal dus kun tu: bar 'ga' mi rtag 'chi ba bsgom: bar do'i gdams pa dran par bya: bar 'ga' sgyu ma rmi lam bsgom: ka dag chos sku'i rtsal sbyang bya: bar 'ga' mnyam rdzogs chos su bsgom: 'od gsal dag pa'i lam khyer bya: bar 'ga' gang shar chos sku la: dug lnga rang grol lam khyer bya: mdor na tha mal spangs byas la: nyin mtshan dge bas 'da' bar bya: tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par nges: e ma ho: mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i man ngag las: yang gsang zab mo'i byin rlabs thugs sgrub bkod: tshegs chung sgrub sla 'bras bu don che ba: 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med: de phyir skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs: byin rlabs thugs sgrub dri med 'od zer gyis gangs ri thod dkar du bkod pa rdzogs so: maṅgalaṃ: ཿ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)shog ser skor las: byin rlabs thugs sgrub/ - PAGE 24 -- PAGE 25 -- PAGE 22 -
